title: Invoices whose service period differs from the invoice month
prompt: Which customer invoices have service periods that differ from the invoice month, and what amounts relate to each service month?

inputs.name: Customer invoices or billing schedules not attached in Dime

steps: pull the month's customer invoices with service dates and line items
split each invoice amount across the service months it covers
list invoices whose service period is outside the invoice month
tie the invoice total to the month's revenue

done.text: Every exception row cites the invoice id
invoice-service-periods.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
The number of invoices flagged is plausible for this entity (advisory)
Invoice dates are never treated as recognition dates; the breakdown shows the amount per service month
